headline: RBNZ expected to hold OCR steady Wednesday amid inflation
caption: Good news for East Auckland homeowners watching interest rates! Bank economists are tipping the RBNZ to hold the Official Cash Rate steady this Wednesday, which means mortgage rates should remain stable for now. If you've been waiting to make a move, this certainty might help with your planning. 🏠
original_title: RBNZ tipped to hold off increasing the OCR at Wednesday's review
